title: Design System: Paddock Pilot — Stable journal

display.purpose: Sentence-case shared headings; 600 and 1.15 line height.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Interior feedback with stationary control hit targets.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: In-place fill for bordered choices and four-pixel action-content transitions, with fixed button geometry.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Measured optional content with a short inner fade and settle; drafts stay mounted.

motion.name: confirmation
motion.purpose: Drawn journal check only after acknowledged local completion.

motion.name: distance
motion.purpose: Maximum routine directional travel; counters use 2px.

motion.name: layout-spring
motion.purpose: Bounded list and continuous borderless segmented-track selection continuity.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: No spatial travel or height tween; short fades
motion.purpose: Live shared preference policy; CSS also reduces transitions and disables smooth scrolling.

motion.name: overlay
motion.purpose: Dialog arrival: 6px translate and 0.985 scale; exit: 140ms and 4px. Base UI retains lifecycle and focus ownership.

components.description: Shared app action; default and solid share the primary appearance.

narrative.overview:
A warm, readable working journal for stable plans, horse records and everyday care. Alegreya headings and Alegreya Sans body text give the app its character. A soft stone canvas, paper working sections and gently alternating rows keep real records easy to scan. Evergreen actions, pale stone selection and burgundy destructive states have distinct jobs.

This is the canonical shared **application** system, grounded in [src/styles.css](src/styles.css), [dashboard primitives](src/components/dashboard), [UI primitives](src/components/ui) and the [design lab](src/components/design/StableDesignGuidelines.tsx). The public landing has its own [scoped design record](docs/design/landing/DESIGN.md).

The shared foundation is implemented. Some specialized components and route-local overrides still need review by page family; this document does not certify every app screen as fully migrated. The lab demonstrates sample day selection and local care completion with undo. Confirmed care completion now uses the shared journal-check sequence; cross-route horse photo morphing remains an intentional exception.
keyCharacteristics: Sentence-case serif headings and readable sans-serif records.
Soft paper sections on a soft stone canvas, with open, alternating record rows.
Distinct action, selection and destructive colors in both themes.
Useful interaction feedback without decorative headings, patterns or imagery.

rules.name: The Separate States Rule
rules.body: Evergreen means action, pale stone with deep neutral ink means selection, and burgundy means destructive feedback. Keep these roles distinct when adding a new control.

rules.name: The Shared Type Rule
rules.body: Use `DashboardDisplayHeading`, section/page headers, `DashboardInlineHeader`, `TextLabel` and record/detail primitives before adding local heading recipes.

rules.name: The Flat Default Rule
rules.body: Start with open sections and divided rows. Choose a contained surface for a specific boundary, not for every piece of content.

dos: Do use shared semantic tokens and primitives across light and dark themes.
Do keep headings in sentence case and records readable at the established body sizes.
Do use open sections, flat rows and quiet dividers as the default.
Do preserve working navigation, permissions, loading, error, empty and undo behavior while changing presentation.
Do label sample data and local-only interactions honestly.
donts: Don't restore condensed uppercase display type, decorative eyebrows, heading icons, background patterns or marketing imagery in app chrome.
Don't confuse warm ink selection with burgundy destructive states.
Don't add nested card stacks, ambient shadows or decorative accent rails to ordinary records.
Don't duplicate shared button, field, tab, badge or record-row styling in feature files.
Don't claim prototype interactions or every page-family migration are complete without implementation and review.
